sentences.text: BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE SUBODH ABHYANKAR  ON THE 15 th OF JULY, 2024  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 28467 of 2024  GANGADHAR  Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH

Appearance:
 (SHRI RISHIRAJ TRIVEDI - ADVOCATE FOR APPLICANT)
 (SHRI TARUN PAGARE - G.A./P.L. FOR STATE)
 ORDER 1.
They are heard.
Perused the case-diary.

2. This is the applicant's first application under Section 438 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 for grant of anticipatory bail, as he is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.241/2024 registered at Police Station Tukoganj, District Indore (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 376, 323 and 504 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
3. The allegation against the applicant is of rape.
4. Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the FIR in the present case has been lodged on 05.04.2024 in respect of the incidents, which took place on 03.01.2024 and 09.03.2024.

It is also submitted that prior to the present FIR, an FIR was also lodged by the prosecutrix on 20.03.2024 against the real sister and nephew of the present applicant and at that time also she could have made allegations against the applicant.
However, since the prosecutrix herself was a consenting party, she did not lodge any such report on 20.03.2024.

It is further submitted that on 11.03.2024 the applicant and the 2 MCRC-28467-2024 prosecutrix had also gone to the police station in respect of their dispute in which the prosecutrix has also given in writing that she does not want any action against the applicant.
Thus, it is submitted that the custodial interrogation of the applicant is not necessary.
5. Counsel for the State, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer and it is submitted that certain abrasions are also there on the person of the prosecutrix.

sentences.text: In rebuttal, counsel for the applicant has submitted that a dispute is already going on between the parties, in which a scuffle had also taken place, which resulted in the aforesaid abrasions.

7. Having considered rival submissions, perusal of the case-diary and the fact that the FIR has been lodged on 05.04.2024 in respect of the incidents, which took place on 03.01.2024 and 09.03.2024 and apart from that a perusal of the FIR also reveals that the prosecutrix was a consenting party and it might be that the applicant entered into the physical relationship with the prosecutrix with some pretext, but that itself cannot be a ground to deny anticipatory bail to the present applicant and considering the fact that the prosecutrix is 37 years old, this Court is of the considered opinion that the custodial interrogation of the applicant is not necessary in the present case.

In view of the same,
applicant has made out a case for grant of anticipatory bail.
8. Accordingly, this application is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest, applicant shall be released on bail, upon his executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (rupees twenty five thousand only) and furnishing one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer).
The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a Police Officer, as and when required.
He shall further abide 3 MCRC-28467-2024 by the other conditions enumerated in Sub Section (2) of Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
Certified copy as per rules.
(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE Pankaj Gangadhar
